reader.requirement: An indexed DELETE succeeds only on a file open in the I-O mode; a DELETE on a file not open, open INPUT or OUTPUT (or after a failed OPEN) is unsuccessful with I-O status 49 and removes nothing; DELETE on a non-mass-storage (sequential-organization) file is not a 1985 form at all.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility: off at 85, so a lone connector never meets a lock conflict; it does not reach the open-mode test

reader.edition-search: IndexedConnector.Delete and FileConnector.MutationOpenModeGuard read no Edition; grep of Runtime/IO for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect lists FileConnector.Edition, sharing, CLOSE WITH LOCK and READ-only rows, none in Delete; KeyedIoEmitter.EmitDelete has no edition test
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf30_04 covers I-O success and open INPUT (49); never-opened, open OUTPUT and after a failed OPEN are not exercised

probes.printed: NOT OPEN 49 / OUTPUT 49 / INPUT 49 (USE runs each time); DEL K01 00 in I-O
probes.expected: IX.1.3.4 49: DELETE attempted on a file not open in the I-O mode

probes.printed: OPEN IO ABSENT 35 / DELETE AFTER FAILED OPEN 49
probes.expected: a failed OPEN leaves the file not open: 49

probes.printed: COBOL0865: DELETE RECORD shall not be specified for sequential-organization file 'SQ' (ISO §2023:14.9.10.3 SR1)
probes.expected: Sequential I-O at 1985 has no DELETE statement: refuse

reader.notes: MutationOpenModeGuard answers 49 for every connector not open I-O before any key work, shared with REWRITE. The sequential-file refusal at 85 cites the 2023 clause rather than a 1985 one, a citation nit outside this rule.

refuter.evidence: E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-093/del3.cob (del3-001), --std 85: indexed sequential file opened EXTEND (a 1985 indexed OPEN form, catalog 1985-FMT-IX.4.4.2): DELETE gives 49 with USE, nothing removed (LEFT 001AAA, 002BBB); random file OPEN I-O then CLOSE then DELETE gives 49 and the record survives (STILL 001AAA 00). Together with the reader's never-opened/INPUT/OUTPUT/failed-OPEN probes, every non-I-O state answers 49. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.3.4 GR1.
